ConnectionStrings._comment: Leads is deliberately empty here. It is a secret, it differs per environment, and a placeholder in source control is how a placeholder ends up in production. Set ConnectionStrings__Leads as a Container Apps secret; the app refuses to start without it outside the tests.

Cors._comment: AllowedOrigins is deliberately empty here: the real origins differ per environment and belong in configuration, not in source control. Set Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 (and __1, ...) as Container Apps environment variables. WARNING - unlike ConnectionStrings:Leads above, nothing guards this one. With the list empty the app starts normally and every instrument stays green: curl works, /health/ready answers Healthy, and the integration tests pass because not one of them sends an Origin header. The only thing that breaks is the browser, which blocks every cross-origin request from the UI with no server-side trace. See TD-022.
